about: Pure-Ergo proclimit DoD guards: span-queue fault identification, limit reporting, and host/cgroup quota derivation.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-proclimit-any-frame
mutants.rule: A fatal SIGSEGV in a non-span-queue frame stays an unexplained crash rather than QueueFault.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-proclimit-addr-nonzero
mutants.rule: Only a SIGSEGV at address zero qualifies as a collector span-queue nil-ring fault.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-proclimit-issue-unnamed
mutants.from:
case QueueFault:
		text = text + "; the Go runtime stopped it with SIGSEGV in its collector's span queue, not with an out-of-memory report (Go runtime bug \(RuntimeIssue), \(RuntimeIssueURL))"
mutants.to:
case QueueFault:
		text = text + RuntimeIssue[0:0] + RuntimeIssueURL[0:0]
mutants.rule: A span-queue LimitError must include the Go runtime issue identifier.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-proclimit-workers-cap
mutants.rule: DeriveQuota must honor a positive capWorkers ceiling.
